subject: Re: Kickoff: Project Vantage — staffing + compute
body:
Hi Lucia,

Vantage staffing: Yusuf Keita 40% leads the perceptual analysis and owns the recommendation methodology; Bilal Novak 50% builds the Vantage eval harness (encoder wrappers for MozJPEG, libjpeg-turbo, jpegli; bitrate-ladder generation; metric computation); Oyin Iversen 25% on corpus sampling from our serving logs so the bake-off images match what we actually serve, not just the CID22-derived set.

Compute: tiny by portfolio standards — encoding sweeps and metric computation on 8 titan-a100 GPUs best-effort, mostly CPU anyway.

Budget flag: if we want a human-rated confirmation batch on our own corpus (Yusuf strongly recommends it — the mucped23 ratings cover the public sources, not our distribution), that's an external rater spend, ballpark $12k. I'll bring the exact number to the Vantage weekly sync.

One process note: encoder licensing review for jpegli redistribution is with Kofi, 2–3 week SLA, started today so it doesn't gate the July recommendation.

Ivo
